Name: NPC Love Letters
Author: handzup89
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Love Letters is a Stardew Valley mod that makes villagers send you handwritten letters with pictures in your postbox as your friendship with them grows. Vanilla mail is text-only — this mod adds a picture to the letter, rendering it inside the vanilla letter viewer so each message feels like a real, hand-drawn note from the NPC.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]1. Install SMAPI 4.3.0 or later (see the SMAPI wiki for instructions).
2. Copy the Love Letters folder into your game's Mods/ directory. It contains: the mod DLL, manifest.json, config.json, ConfigSchema.json, letters.json, and the pictures/ folder.
3. (Optional) Install Generic Mod Config Menu if you want an in-game settings UI instead of editing config.json by hand.
4. Launch the game. SMAPI will load the mod automatically — no extra steps needed.

To add your own letters, edit letters.json and drop PNG images into the pictures/ folder. No recompilation required; pictures are loaded at runtime.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Two files in the mod folder control behaviour. Both can be edited by hand, or in-game via the Generic Mod Config Menu.

--- config.json ---

{
  "Enabled": true,
  "MaxMailboxLetters": 4,
  "ImageMaxPixels": 512,
  "ImageMaxHeight": 440
}

Field — What it does — Default — Valid range
• Enabled — Master switch; false disables all letter delivery entirely. — true — true / false
• MaxMailboxLetters — Max undelivered love letters allowed in the mailbox at once; extras wait until earlier ones are read. — 4 — 1 to 20
• ImageMaxPixels — Pictures larger than this on their longest side are downscaled on load to keep memory low. — 512 — 64 to 4096
• ImageMaxHeight — Max height, in base-resolution pixels, a picture may occupy inside the letter; text paginates below it. — 440 — 96 to 560

Tip: if your pictures are small (under 512 px), you can leave ImageMaxPixels at its default. Lower ImageMaxHeight if you prefer a bigger text area.

--- letters.json ---

Each entry in the JSON array defines one letter. Add new entries to create more letters — no code changes or recompilation needed.

Example — a new letter for Abigail at 6 hearts:
{
  "Id": "LoveLetters_abigail_6",
  "Npc": "Abigail",
  "MinHearts": 6,
  "Text": "@, I finally finished the portrait you asked for. ^It took me all week, but I think you'll like it.",
  "Image": "pictures/abigail/hearts6.png",
  "Title": "Your Portrait"
}

Field — What it does
• Id — Unique mail ID. Always prefix with "LoveLetters_" to avoid collisions with other mods. Use one distinct ID per letter (e.g. LoveLetters_abigail_2, _4, _6).
• Npc — The NPC's internal name (e.g. "Abigail", "Leah", "Penny", "Sebastian"). The mod checks your friendship heart level against this name.
• MinHearts — The friendship heart level at which the letter is delivered. Ranges 0–8 (8 = 4000 friendship points).
• Text — The letter body. Supports vanilla mail formatting: @ = player's name, ^ = line break, [letterbg #] = choose a parchment background (0–3).
• Image — Path to a picture, relative to the mod folder (e.g. "pictures/abigail/hearts6.png"). Leave null or omit for a text-only letter. PNG works best; BMP/DDS/JPEG also load in most cases.
• Title — Shown on hover in Collections → Letters. Falls back to "Letter from {Npc}" when omitted.

Example — a text-only letter (no picture):
{
  "Id": "LoveLetters_leah_8",
  "Npc": "Leah",
  "MinHearts": 8,
  "Text": "@, I've been meaning to tell you something for a while now. ^Let's grab lunch tomorrow? I could use some company.",
  "Title": "A Little Confession"
}

Picture folder layout — drop your PNGs here, grouped by NPC:
pictures/
├── abigail/
│  ├── hearts2.png
│  ├── hearts4.png
│  └── hearts8.png
├── leah/
│  ├── hearts2.png
│  └── hearts4.png
├── penny/
│  ├── hearts2.png
│  └── hearts6.png
└── sebastian/
    └── hearts4.png

The bundled mod ships 8 letters (Abigail x3, Leah x2, Penny x2, Sebastian x1). A missing image file never crashes the mod — it logs a warning and falls back to a text-only letter instead.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]- Picture letters: each letter shows a text message and a picture inside the vanilla letter menu. The picture scales to fit and the text paginates below it.
- Heart-threshold delivery: letters are delivered to the postbox once friendship with a given NPC reaches the configured heart level. Each letter is sent only once (tracked via the persistent mailReceived flag).
- Collections tab support: letters also render their picture when re-read from Collections → Letters, so you can revisit them without opening the mailbox.
- Data-driven: all letters are defined in letters.json (NPC name, heart threshold, text, image path, optional collection title). Add, edit, or remove letters without touching any code.
- Flexible image handling: images are loaded at runtime from the mod folder, cached, and downscaled to keep memory usage low. If a picture file is missing, the mod falls back to a text-only letter without crashing.
- Mailbox cap: a configurable limit (default 4) prevents the mailbox from overflowing. Letters beyond the cap wait until earlier ones are read.
- Multiplayer & split-screen: each player gets letters based on their own friendship, and the Collections tab swap runs per-player every tick.
- Settings (config.json or via Generic Mod Config Menu): master enable toggle, max mailbox letters, max picture size (pixels), and max picture height inside the letter.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]- Stardew Valley 1.6
- SMAPI 4.3.0 or later
- (Optional) Generic Mod Config Menu for in-game settings
- No other mods required.[/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Thanks to Pathoschild for creating and maintaining SMAPI and the SMAPI Toolkit, which make mods like this possible. And thanks to ConcernedApe for making a game that keeps surprising me.[/color][/size]
